summary: Backend-only regression verification of the HEB resume PDF rendering fix (variant-D spacing + keep-with-next in backend/resume_export.py build_pdf). Authoritative TestArtifactCorrections suite passes (4/4). Independent pymupdf render from tests/fixtures/heb_rep.json confirms page_count=2 (<=2 target met, down from 3), US-formatted phone '(210) 550-0251' present and raw '12105500251' absent, both https hyperlinks (github.com/JamesOWilliams, linkedin.com/in/jwilliams1217) are embedded, all three section labels (Experience / Military Service / Independent Projects) render, named IP projects (DIE Orbit, DPO Foundry) appear with no bare 'Developer — Independent Project' placeholder, and no orphaned entry heading is detected (every role heading shares its page with its first bullet).

minor.issue: 5 pre-existing TestGoldenPath failures unrelated to the rendering fix: 4 return 409 identity_incomplete because the admin/golden profile in this preview env lacks name/location/contact (resolved in UX via the Identity & Contact panel per iteration_7, but the pytest seed data is not populated); and test_validation_gates_pass expects 10 gate_results while the server now returns 11 (new gate added). Neither is caused by the resume_export spacing change.

verification_details.pytest_full: pytest tests/backend_test.py -q => 61 passed, 5 failed (all 5 in TestGoldenPath; pre-existing env/seed + gate-count issues, not regressions from this fix)

action_items: (Not blocking this fix) Main agent: seed the admin/golden-path profile with identity (name/location/contact) in the pytest fixture setup so the 4 export GoldenPath tests pass, and update test_validation_gates_pass expected length from 10 to 11 to match the new gate list ['canonical_truth','evidence','metric_integrity','chronology','relationship_integrity','jd_relevance',...].
critical_code_review_comments: resume_export.build_pdf change is minimally invasive and correct: using sec.keepWithNext / role.keepWithNext / meta.keepWithNext for orphan-prevention is the right ReportLab idiom; replacing per-entry KeepTogether removes the forced-page-break-when-overflowing failure mode that caused the trailing nearly-empty page 3.

Variant-D spacing deltas are modest (sec spaceBefore 7->5, spaceAfter 3->2; body leading 13.5->12.5; role 12.5->12; bullet 12.5->11.5 + spaceAfter 1; inter-entry spacer 3->2; margins 0.55in/0.5in). Visual inspection of the rendered 2-page PDF shows no clipping or overlap — bullets remain readable at 9.5pt with 11.5 leading.
backend_test.py: TestGoldenPath::test_validation_gates_pass hardcodes `== 10` for gate count — this is brittle; prefer assertion on required gate names being a subset of gate_results.keys().

success_rate.backend: 92% (61/66 pytest tests; 100% on the rendering-fix-related TestArtifactCorrections; 5 pre-existing TestGoldenPath failures unrelated to this change)

test_credentials: Not required — regression runs from backend fixture directly (tests/fixtures/heb_rep.json).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The HEB rendering fix is verified. If re-visiting: (1) 4 TestArtifactCorrections tests cover the pagination/orphan/phone/qualifier regressions and must stay green; (2) the independent pymupdf verifier lives at /app/backend/tests/verify_heb_pdf.py and is a quick sanity check without needing the live export API; (3) the 5 TestGoldenPath failures are pre-existing environmental/seed issues, not rendering regressions — do not attribute to resume_export changes.
